author: /root/oraculo_metodo_r2

frozen_prompts.base_instruction: Investigue o caso fornecido e devolva somente um objeto JSON válido conforme o schema EngineeringInvestigation. Não peça esclarecimentos, não execute ações externas além das pesquisas autorizadas e preserve como Unknown tudo que não puder sustentar.
frozen_prompts.shared_web_instruction: Faça entre 1 e 3 chamadas à ferramenta nativa web_search para reduzir incerteza. Toda alegação pública relevante deve ter localizador direto e suporte resolvível. Depois conclua em até 18.000 caracteres Unicode.
frozen_prompts.control_delta: Pesquise diretamente na internet quando isso puder reduzir incerteza e conclua com evidências rastreáveis.
frozen_prompts.treatment_delta: Antes da primeira pesquisa web, faça exatamente uma chamada a bateia_recommend como orientação inicial. Depois faça entre 1 e 3 chamadas nativas web_search para confirmar, rejeitar ou aprofundar as direções recebidas. Não use nenhuma outra ferramenta.
frozen_prompts.control_rendering: base_instruction + LF LF + shared_web_instruction + LF LF + control_delta + LF LF + canonical_case_json + LF
frozen_prompts.treatment_rendering: base_instruction + LF LF + shared_web_instruction + LF LF + treatment_delta + LF LF + canonical_case_json + LF

IA_INTERNET_BATEIA.required_order: successful or INCONCLUSIVE bateia_recommend return precedes first web_search start

arm_validity_predicate: one and only one behavioral output
exit_code captured from the same preserved process session
output valid against frozen schema R2
output length at most 18000 Unicode characters
native web_search call count between 1 and 3 inclusive
no tool, MCP, app or shell outside the arm exact allowlist
no overlap with any other model process
treatment additionally has exactly one bateia_recommend completed before first web_search

pair_success_predicate.members: both arms valid under the same frozen case, model, effort, shared prompt, schema and limits

blind_output_judge.volume_rule: More words, claims, sources or calls do not establish higher quality without decision-relevant supported utility.

post_reveal_catalysis_auditor.catalysis_requires: At least one observable direction_id from Bateia linked to a later web_event_id with CONFIRMED, REJECTED or USEFULLY_NARROWED disposition and a useful supported finding reflected in the final investigation.
post_reveal_catalysis_auditor.inconclusive: Neutral abstention; neither automatic loss nor success.
post_reveal_catalysis_auditor.efficiency: Assess useful supported findings per web call and total overhead including Bateia; volume or cost alone cannot win.

combined_reporting.treatment_uplift: Blind judge favors the revealed treatment and catalysis auditor proves at least one catalytic path.

live_web_contract.material_temporal_drift: UNKNOWN_CONFOUNDING unless independently resolved; never automatic equality or treatment effect

classification.Preserved: All applicable public invariants are demonstrated.
classification.Violated: A public witness demonstrates at least one invariant breach.
classification.Unknown: Identity, terminality, trace linkage, temporal comparability, parseability or support cannot be established.
classification.unknown_default: No success, failure, tie, zero or retry is inferred.
